name: Subset Teaching Dimension of the Three-Code Class
proof: The ordinary one-point teaching samples $x_0=0$ for $000$, $x_1=1$ for $011$, and $x_2=1$ for $101$ are each contained in no ordinary minimum teaching sample of either other target.  They therefore remain subset-teaching samples at every iteration.  An empty sample identifies no target, so the stabilized maximum is one.
